qualities.leather: leather with fine grain, supple folds and restrained broad highlights
qualities.silk: silk with smooth flowing folds and soft directional lustre
qualities.satin: satin with smooth folds and broad directional sheen
qualities.cotton: cotton with subtle woven texture and mostly diffuse matte shading
qualities.linen: linen with irregular woven texture, crisp folds and diffuse highlights
qualities.wool: wool with soft fibrous texture and diffuse matte shading
qualities.knit: knit with coherent existing stitches and soft diffuse shading
qualities.lace: lace with coherent existing openwork and delicate light passing through its openings
qualities.translucent fabric: translucent fabric with gentle light transmission and layered soft shadows
qualities.denim: denim with subtle twill texture, sturdy folds and matte shading
qualities.velvet: velvet with soft pile, deep fold shadows and restrained directional sheen
qualities.fur: fur with coherent existing tufts and soft light scattered through their edges
qualities.metal: metal garment panels with coherent existing reflections and controlled highlights
